from manim import *

class StickmanScene4(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        # Background and floor
        self.camera.background_color = "#E8C555" # Yellow background
        
        floor = Rectangle(width=15, height=4, color=BLACK, fill_color="#8F7861", fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=6)
        floor.to_edge(DOWN, buff=0)
        
        # Floor lines to simulate stone
        f_line1 = Line(floor.get_left() + UP*1, floor.get_right() + UP*1, color=BLACK, stroke_width=4)
        f_line2 = Line(floor.get_left() + DOWN*0.5, floor.get_right() + DOWN*0.5, color=BLACK, stroke_width=4)
        
        floor_group = VGroup(floor, f_line1, f_line2)
        
        # Head
        head = Circle(radius=1.5, color=BLACK, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=8)
        head.shift(UP * 1.5)
        
        # Ears
        left_ear = Circle(radius=0.25, color=BLACK, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=6)
        left_ear.move_to(head.get_left() + RIGHT * 0.1)
        
        right_ear = Circle(radius=0.25, color=BLACK, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=6)
        right_ear.move_to(head.get_right() + LEFT * 0.1)
        
        # Hairs
        hair1 = ArcBetweenPoints(head.get_top() + LEFT*0.3, head.get_top() + LEFT*0.5 + UP*0.4, angle=-PI/4, color=BLACK, stroke_width=5)
        hair2 = ArcBetweenPoints(head.get_top(), head.get_top() + RIGHT*0.1 + UP*0.5, angle=-PI/4, color=BLACK, stroke_width=5)
        hair3 = ArcBetweenPoints(head.get_top() + RIGHT*0.3, head.get_top() + RIGHT*0.5 + UP*0.4, angle=-PI/4, color=BLACK, stroke_width=5)
        
        # Eyes
        left_eye_group = VGroup()
        left_eye_bg = Circle(radius=0.35, color=BLACK, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=6)
        left_eyelid = Line(left_eye_bg.get_left(), left_eye_bg.get_right(), color=BLACK, stroke_width=8)
        left_pupil = Dot(radius=0.1, color=BLACK)
        left_pupil.move_to(left_eye_bg.get_center())
        left_pupil.shift(DOWN * 0.05)
        left_eye_group.add(left_eye_bg, left_eyelid, left_pupil)
        left_eye_group.move_to(head.get_center() + LEFT*0.5 + UP*0.2)
        
        right_eye_group = VGroup()
        right_eye_bg = Circle(radius=0.35, color=BLACK, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=6)
        right_eyelid = Line(right_eye_bg.get_left(), right_eye_bg.get_right(), color=BLACK, stroke_width=8)
        right_pupil = Dot(radius=0.1, color=BLACK)
        right_pupil.move_to(right_eye_bg.get_center())
        right_pupil.shift(DOWN * 0.05)
        right_eye_group.add(right_eye_bg, right_eyelid, right_pupil)
        right_eye_group.move_to(head.get_center() + RIGHT*0.5 + UP*0.2)
        
        # Eyebrows
        left_eyebrow = Line(left_eye_group.get_center() + LEFT*0.4 + UP*0.5, left_eye_group.get_center() + RIGHT*0.4 + UP*0.5, color=BLACK, stroke_width=8)
        right_eyebrow = Line(right_eye_group.get_center() + LEFT*0.4 + UP*0.5, right_eye_group.get_center() + RIGHT*0.4 + UP*0.5, color=BLACK, stroke_width=8)
        
        # Nose
        nose = ArcBetweenPoints(head.get_center() + LEFT*0.15 + DOWN*0.1, head.get_center() + RIGHT*0.15 + DOWN*0.1, angle=PI*1.2, color=BLACK, stroke_width=6)
        
        # Mouth
        mouth = ArcBetweenPoints(head.get_center() + LEFT*0.6 + DOWN*0.7, head.get_center() + RIGHT*0.6 + DOWN*0.7, angle=-PI/6, color=BLACK, stroke_width=7)
        
        face = VGroup(left_eye_group, right_eye_group, left_eyebrow, right_eyebrow, nose, mouth)
        
        # Body
        body = Ellipse(width=2.2, height=3.5, color=BLACK, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=8)
        body.next_to(head, DOWN, buff=-0.3)
        
        # Legs
        left_leg = Line(body.get_bottom() + LEFT*0.4 + UP*0.2, body.get_bottom() + LEFT*0.5 + DOWN*2, color=BLACK, stroke_width=8)
        right_leg = Line(body.get_bottom() + RIGHT*0.4 + UP*0.2, body.get_bottom() + RIGHT*0.5 + DOWN*2, color=BLACK, stroke_width=8)
        
        # Feet
        left_foot = Ellipse(width=0.8, height=0.3, color=BLACK, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=6)
        left_foot.move_to(left_leg.get_end() + RIGHT*0.1)
        
        right_foot = Ellipse(width=0.8, height=0.3, color=BLACK, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=6)
        right_foot.move_to(right_leg.get_end() + RIGHT*0.1)
        
        # Shadows
        left_shadow = Ellipse(width=1.0, height=0.3, color=BLACK, fill_color=BLACK, fill_opacity=0.3, stroke_width=0)
        left_shadow.move_to(left_foot.get_center() + DOWN*0.05)
        
        right_shadow = Ellipse(width=1.0, height=0.3, color=BLACK, fill_color=BLACK, fill_opacity=0.3, stroke_width=0)
        right_shadow.move_to(right_foot.get_center() + DOWN*0.05)
        
        # Arms
        left_arm_top = body.get_left() + UP*0.5
        left_elbow = left_arm_top + LEFT*1.2 + DOWN*1.5
        left_hand_pos = body.get_left() + DOWN*0.8 + RIGHT*0.3
        
        left_arm_part1 = Line(left_arm_top, left_elbow, color=BLACK, stroke_width=8)
        left_arm_part2 = Line(left_elbow, left_hand_pos, color=BLACK, stroke_width=8)
        left_arm = VGroup(left_arm_part1, left_arm_part2)
        
        left_hand = Ellipse(width=0.6, height=0.8, color=BLACK, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=6)
        left_hand.move_to(left_hand_pos)
        left_hand_finger = Arc(radius=0.15, angle=PI, color=BLACK, stroke_width=5).rotate(-PI/2).move_to(left_hand.get_center() + RIGHT*0.1)
        
        right_arm_top = body.get_right() + UP*0.5
        right_elbow = right_arm_top + RIGHT*1.2 + DOWN*1.5
        right_hand_pos = body.get_right() + DOWN*0.8 + LEFT*0.3
        
        right_arm_part1 = Line(right_arm_top, right_elbow, color=BLACK, stroke_width=8)
        right_arm_part2 = Line(right_elbow, right_hand_pos, color=BLACK, stroke_width=8)
        right_arm = VGroup(right_arm_part1, right_arm_part2)
        
        right_hand = Ellipse(width=0.6, height=0.8, color=BLACK, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=6)
        right_hand.move_to(right_hand_pos)
        right_hand_finger = Arc(radius=0.15, angle=PI, color=BLACK, stroke_width=5).rotate(PI/2).move_to(right_hand.get_center() + LEFT*0.1)
        
        # Z-index logic
        left_ear.set_z_index(0)
        right_ear.set_z_index(0)
        left_arm.set_z_index(1)
        right_arm.set_z_index(1)
        left_leg.set_z_index(1)
        right_leg.set_z_index(1)
        body.set_z_index(2)
        left_hand.set_z_index(3)
        left_hand_finger.set_z_index(4)
        right_hand.set_z_index(3)
        right_hand_finger.set_z_index(4)
        head.set_z_index(5)
        hair1.set_z_index(6)
        hair2.set_z_index(6)
        hair3.set_z_index(6)
        face.set_z_index(6)
        left_foot.set_z_index(2)
        right_foot.set_z_index(2)
        floor_group.set_z_index(-1)
        left_shadow.set_z_index(-1)
        right_shadow.set_z_index(-1)
        
        character = VGroup(
            left_ear, right_ear, left_leg, right_leg, left_foot, right_foot,
            left_arm, right_arm, left_hand, left_hand_finger, right_hand, right_hand_finger,
            body, head, hair1, hair2, hair3, face
        )
        
        # Animation
        self.add(floor_group, left_shadow, right_shadow)
        self.play(Create(character), run_time=2.5)
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        # Blink animation
        closed_left_eye = Line(left_eye_group.get_left(), left_eye_group.get_right(), color=BLACK, stroke_width=8)
        closed_left_eye.move_to(left_eye_group.get_center())
        closed_right_eye = Line(right_eye_group.get_left(), right_eye_group.get_right(), color=BLACK, stroke_width=8)
        closed_right_eye.move_to(right_eye_group.get_center())
        
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(left_eye_group, closed_left_eye), ReplacementTransform(right_eye_group, closed_right_eye), run_time=0.1)
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(closed_left_eye, left_eye_group), ReplacementTransform(closed_right_eye, right_eye_group), run_time=0.1)
        self.wait(1)
